title: Источник Wazuh
description: Алерты менеджера Wazuh: по серьёзности, правилам, агентам, тактикам MITRE, комплаенс.

panels.title: Алерты по серьёзности
panels.sql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, countIf(rule_level < 7) AS low, countIf(rule_level BETWEEN 7 AND 11) AS high, countIf(rule_level >= 12) AS critical FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Всего / критичных
panels.sql: SELECT count() AS alerts, countIf(rule_level >= 12) AS critical FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Compliance, %
panels.sql: SELECT round(100 * avg(compliant), 1) AS compliance FROM policy_verdicts WHERE evaluated_at = (SELECT max(evaluated_at) FROM policy_verdicts)

panels.title: Топ правил
panels.sql: SELECT concat(toString(rule_id), ' · ', any(rule_description)) AS rule, count() AS alerts FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY rule_id ORDER BY alerts DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Тактики MITRE ATT&CK
panels.sql: SELECT tactic, count() AS alerts FROM wazuh_alerts ARRAY JOIN mitre_tactics AS tactic WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY tactic ORDER BY alerts DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Агенты
panels.sql: SELECT agent_name, count() AS alerts, countIf(rule_level >= 12) AS critical, max(timestamp) AS last FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND agent_name != '' GROUP BY agent_name ORDER BY alerts DESC

panels.title: Нарушения политик
panels.sql: SELECT policy, entity_name, arrayStringConcat(violations, '; ') AS violations FROM policy_verdicts WHERE compliant = 0 AND evaluated_at = (SELECT max(evaluated_at) FROM policy_verdicts) ORDER BY policy, entity_name LIMIT 50
